description: Manages communication records, meetings, calls, and other forms of engagement with partners and contacts. It allows for creation, retrieval, update, deletion, and advanced searching of interaction data.

exampleCriteria.description: Find interactions with contacts named John

endpoints.name: Create
endpoints.description: Creates a new interaction record with complete details including participants, type, and associated entities.

req.description: Interaction creation request with all required details (e.g., type, date, subject, description, participants).

example_uses: Create a new meeting with UNICEF on project planning
Record email interaction with partner contacts
Add conference call with multiple stakeholders
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to create, add, record, or log a new interaction, meeting, call, or communication.

endpoints.name: ListAllInteractions
endpoints.description: Retrieves all interactions with basic pagination and ordering (no search criteria). This endpoint is for general listing and does not support advanced filtering. For specific searches, use the 'SearchInteractions' or 'AdvancedSearchInteractions' endpoints.

ascending.description: Sort direction - true for ascending, false for descending (default: true)

example_uses: List all interactions in the system
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to see ALL interactions without any search criteria or when asking for a general interaction list.

endpoints.name: SearchInteractions
endpoints.description: Performs simple text search across multiple interaction fields (subject, description, etc.). This endpoint is suitable for keyword-based searches. For structured and relationship-based searches, use 'AdvancedSearchInteractions'.

request.description: Pagination request containing only pagination and sorting parameters

searchText.description: Text to search across interaction subject, description, and other basic fields

endpoints.when_to_use: Use this for simple keyword searches across interaction content. NOT for relationship-based searches.

endpoints.name: AdvancedSearchInteractions
endpoints.description: Performs advanced search with structured criteria including relationships with partners, contacts, dates, and complex filters. The 'searchCriteria' parameter expects a JSON array of objects, where each object defines a filter condition. Each condition must have a 'field', 'operator', and 'value'. An optional 'logicalOperator' (AND/OR) can be used to combine conditions. Available fields for searching include direct fields like 'type', 'date', 'subject', and nested fields like 'partner.name' or 'contact.email'. Refer to the 'searchMetadata' section for a full list of searchable fields and supported operators (e.g., 'like', 'is', 'between', 'greaterThan').

request.description: Pagination request containing only pagination and sorting parameters

searchCriteria.description: JSON array of search criteria objects with field, operator, value, and optional logicalOperator. Example: [{"field": "partner.name", "operator": "like", "value": "UNICEF"}, {"field": "date", "operator": "between", "value": "2024-01-01,2024-12-31", "logicalOperator": "AND"}]

searchText.description: Optional additional text search to combine with criteria

example_uses: Show meetings with John Smith contact
Find conference calls from Finance department contacts
List interactions by type and date range
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this for searches involving partner relationships, contact details, dates, interaction types, or multiple field combinations.

endpoints.name: Get
endpoints.description: Retrieves a specific interaction by ID with complete details including participants, documents, and permissions.
example_uses: Show me details for interaction ID 123
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks for specific interaction details by ID or when you need complete interaction information.

endpoints.name: Update
endpoints.description: Updates an existing interaction's information including details, participants, scheduling, and metadata.

req.description: Interaction update request containing modified fields (e.g., interaction ID, new time, new location, updated participants).

endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to update, modify, edit, or change interaction information.

endpoints.name: Delete
endpoints.description: Soft deletes an interaction from the system (marks as deleted rather than permanent removal).
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user asks to delete, remove, cancel, or eliminate an interaction.

endpoints.name: PermissionsGet
endpoints.description: Retrieves the current user's permissions for a specific interaction (read, update, delete).

id.description: Interaction ID to check permissions for

example_uses: What can I do with meeting 456?
Get access rights for this interaction
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when you need to check user permissions before performing operations or showing UI elements for interaction management.

endpoints.name: ScanInteractionData
endpoints.description: Scans and processes uploaded files for interaction data extraction using AI-powered analysis.

req.description: File scan request containing the file to be processed

example_uses: Scan meeting notes for interaction details
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to upload and scan documents for interaction data extraction using AI.

endpoints.name: AnalyseInteractionData
endpoints.description: Analyzes uploaded files and extracts structured interaction data using AI-powered data analysis.

request.description: Analysis request containing file and analysis parameters

example_uses: Analyze meeting transcripts for structured data extraction
Extract interaction information from uploaded logs
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to analyze files and extract structured interaction data for database import.

endpoints.name: BulkUploadInteractions
endpoints.description: Bulk uploads multiple interaction records using AI-assisted data processing and validation.

req.description: Bulk upload request containing interaction data

example_uses: Import multiple interactions from CSV file
Mass upload interaction data with AI validation
endpoints.when_to_use: Use this when the user wants to upload multiple interaction records at once with AI-assisted processing.
